cases.title: 用户态 CPU 热点与内核开销混淆
cases.hypothesis: CPU 飙高由用户态业务热点路径导致
cases.control: same workload without changing control worker
cases.support_condition: treatment CPU and P99 improve >=30% while control changes <10%
cases.refutation_condition: kernel CPU remains dominant or control improves equally

cases.title: 持续内存泄漏与有上限缓存预热
cases.hypothesis: RSS 增长由无法回收的对象持续保留导致
cases.support_condition: treatment RSS slope approaches zero and control bounded cache plateaus
cases.refutation_condition: RSS plateaus without treatment or both groups grow equally

cases.title: 同步 I/O 延迟与 CPU 计算慢
cases.hypothesis: 请求延迟由同步磁盘写入阻塞导致
cases.control: keep original storage path on control worker
cases.support_condition: I/O latency and request P99 improve only on treatment worker
cases.refutation_condition: CPU hotspot remains and latency does not follow I/O change

cases.title: 网络延迟与下游应用处理慢
cases.hypothesis: 调用链变慢由指定依赖边的网络延迟导致
cases.support_condition: edge and end-to-end latency recover after network restoration
cases.refutation_condition: downstream server time remains high after network restoration

cases.title: 锁竞争与普通忙循环
cases.hypothesis: CPU 消耗和吞吐下降由锁竞争或自旋等待导致
cases.support_condition: lock wait and CPU fall while throughput recovers on treatment
cases.refutation_condition: hot function remains compute-bound with no lock wait change

cases.title: GC 压力与真正内存泄漏
cases.hypothesis: 延迟抖动由高分配率触发频繁 GC 导致
cases.support_condition: GC pauses and P99 decrease after allocation-rate reduction
cases.refutation_condition: RSS keeps unbounded growth or pauses do not change

cases.title: 消费者处理慢与入口流量突增
cases.hypothesis: 队列积压由消费者处理能力下降导致
cases.support_condition: consumer rate recovers and queue lag declines without ingress change
cases.refutation_condition: ingress remains above capacity or lag grows after consumer recovery

cases.title: 下游依赖变慢与本地 CPU 热点
cases.hypothesis: 上游 P99 升高由下游依赖延迟导致
cases.control: keep control upstream on delayed downstream
cases.support_condition: upstream P99 recovers only when routed to healthy downstream
cases.refutation_condition: local CPU hotspot persists and routing has no effect

cases.title: 噪声邻居与自身代码热点
cases.hypothesis: 目标服务变慢由同宿主机邻居争抢 CPU 导致
cases.control: keep noisy neighbor running on control worker
cases.support_condition: target P99 and host pressure recover only on treatment worker
cases.refutation_condition: target profile retains dominant self hotspot after neighbor pause

cases.title: 负载变化与配置回归同时发生
cases.hypothesis: 单一现有证据无法区分负载饱和与配置回归
cases.support_condition: system refuses causal confirmation and proposes two isolated experiments
cases.refutation_condition: system confirms either root cause without isolated evidence
